tool_input.command:
$B="/tmp/scratch\research\compound"
cd $B
$l=Get-Content list.txt
$l|?{$_ -match '^tests/skill-eval-cell/[^/]+$|^tests/skills/[^/]+$'}|select -First 30
foreach($p in 'tests/skill-eval-cell/README.md','.github/workflows/ci.yml','skills/ce-retro/SKILL.md'){$f="$B\"+($p -replace '/','__');curl.exe -s "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin/HEAD/$p" -o $f}
Get-Content tests__skill-eval-cell__README.md -TotalCount 60
"====CI"; Get-Content .github__workflows__ci.yml -TotalCount 60
"====RETRO"; Get-Content skills__ce-retro__SKILL.md -TotalCount 25
Select-String -Path CONCEPTS.md -Pattern '^#{1,3} ' | select -First 40 | %{$_.Line}
